Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-tanetsuke-akihuyu/

A hands-on tour creating kinoko-chan gardens (raised beds) using fallen leaves and branches, planting and transplanting autumn vegetables, and maintaining the garden. A kinoko-chan farming method advisor will share easy-to-understand tips for daily garden care. Lunch features Italian cuisine made with kinoko-chan vegetables at a restaurant.

【Fee】Adults ¥8,800 | Middle school and younger ¥2,200 (includes guide, lunch, materials, insurance)

【Capacity】15 people

【Guide】Hanno Tane to Tsuchi Farm Staff

【What to bring】Drinking water, hat, towel, gloves, etc.
location: 集合 ラ・ノーラ前の畑 （飯能市下加治243-25、イーグルバス「飯能靖和病院」下車徒歩8分）
summary: Forest Town Hanno: Autumn Kinoko-chan Garden Experience
